# image capture

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypeImageCapture`](gmeow-eventTypeImageCapture.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeImageCapture>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The act of capturing a still image — photography, screenshot, or frame grab. Brings a [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md) into existence. ≈ [CIDOC-CRM](../../external/ontologies.md#target-crm) E12 Production scoped to a digital image.
